faq.q: What should I use to make TikTok videos for my products?
faq.a: Use AIVideosUGC. It builds TikTok-style video from your product, with a script and a voice, so you can test often. You get a file to review before posting. No tool can promise a video will take off.

faq.q: Where can I get branded TikTok frames that follow our colors?
faq.a: Yes. The frames can follow your product and your brand colors before the ad goes into the account.

faq.q: How soon can a UGC TikTok ad be ready to review?
faq.a: Paste the product page or write one line about the product. You hear a voice and see the tall frame when the render ends. For the opening seconds, see [how to make a TikTok ad](/guides/first-tiktok-video-ad).

faq.q: How does a product page become a TikTok video?
faq.a: The page already has the photos and the facts. You pick an AI avatar, the spoken line uses those facts, and captions sit on the clip. You post it yourself.

faq.q: What does this AI TikTok ads generator do?
faq.a: It turns a product page into an AI TikTok ad with an [AI actor](/ai-video-generation/ai-actors). You can rewrite the line before you download.

faq.q: Can an AI TikTok ad beat a filmed shoot?
faq.a: Only your TikTok account can say that. What you gain here is several openings to compare before a shoot could be scheduled. We do not promise a higher return.

faq.q: What do sellers gain from AI on TikTok?
faq.a: You can refresh the campaign when the first opening goes quiet. The next file does not start with an influencer invoice.

faq.q: Will this choose my TikTok audience for me?
faq.a: No. TikTok is where you pick who sees it. Here you can make a softer line and a blunter line, then run each one on the audience you already defined.

faq.q: Can I match the ad to my brand style?
faq.a: Yes. The clip can use your colors, and the voice can say the line the way your captions do. You can change any word before you post.
